topics.label: Introduction to cancer biology and lecture learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes students, frames the lecture series, and sets out the learning outcomes rather than developing the lecture subject.

topics.label: Accumulation of genetic and epigenetic changes in cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the genetic, epigenetic, and infection-related changes that accumulate during cancer development.

topics.label: Cancer as a failure of differentiation and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains cancer as a breakdown of normal differentiation and the organization of cells within tissues.

topics.label: Cell culture models of cancer and their limitations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic considers how tumor cells are studied in culture and why those models may not capture the full tumor environment.

topics.label: Invasion and metastasis as features of malignant tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how invasion distinguishes malignant from benign tumors and how invasive tumors can spread to distant sites.

topics.label: Progression from benign to malignant tumors and benign tumor risk
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the significance of the benign–malignant distinction for tumor progression and patient risk.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature by tissue of origin and malignancy
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic sets out how tumor names generally indicate their tissue of origin and malignant status.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer-related illness and death
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how tumors disrupt normal bodily functions and how cancer can ultimately cause death.

topics.label: Human and animal tumor incidence patterns
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how tumor incidence varies across human populations and animal species.

topics.label: Clinical presentation and cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain why screening is used and compare screening approaches and their limitations.

topics.label: Lecture close: learning outcomes, revision and practicals
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture by returning to the learning outcomes and directing students to revision and practicals.
